class Plain {
  value = 1;
}
class Hidden {
  private value = 2;
}
class Guarded {
  protected value = 3;
}
class Other {
  private value = 4;
}
interface Shape {
  value: number;
}
function readHidden<T extends Plain | Hidden>(x: T) {
  return x.value;
}
function readGuarded<T extends Plain | Guarded>(x: T) {
  return x.value;
}
function readBothPrivate<T extends Hidden | Other>(x: T) {
  return x.value;
}
function writeHidden<T extends Plain | Hidden>(x: T) {
  x.value = 5;
}
function readInterface<T extends Shape | Hidden>(x: T) {
  return x.value;
}
console.log(readHidden(new Hidden()), readGuarded(new Guarded()), readBothPrivate(new Other()), readInterface(new Hidden()));
writeHidden(new Plain());
